item.title: Anthropic Offers Mythos Upgrade for Cyber Partners and a ‘Safe’ Version for the Rest of You
item.description: Anthropic is releasing Claude Mythos 5 to trusted organizations and Claude Fable 5 to the public, a version it says can’t be used for cyberattacks.

item.title: Alex Vindman Survived Trump’s Retaliation Machine. Now He’s Running for Senate
item.description: In 2019, Alex Vindman testified during President Trump’s first impeachment trial–a decision that ended his military career. Now he wants to challenge the president from the halls of Congress.

item.title: OpenAI Confidentially Files for IPO on the Heels of SpaceX and Anthropic
item.description: The ChatGPT-maker announced it has filed paperwork to go public, just a week after rival Anthropic took the same step.

item.title: Apple’s New Siri AI Is Ready to Get Personal
item.description: From a stand-alone app to a Google Gemini partnership, here’s everything you need to know from WWDC 2026 about Apple’s upcoming overhaul of Siri.

item.title: The UK Is Betting on a Billion-Dollar AI Supercomputer to Kick Its Addiction to US Tech
item.description: The British government thinks a state-backed infrastructure initiative will help supercharge homegrown chip startups.

item.title: Meta Deletes Face-Recognition System From Its Smart Glasses App After WIRED Report
item.description: The code WIRED identified is gone from the latest version of Meta AI, the companion app for the company’s smart glasses. Meta won’t say why or whether it’s coming back.

item.title: Momfluencers Are Pitching AI as a Better ‘Coparent’ Than Men
item.description: Moms are outsourcing tedious household tasks to ChatGPT and selling courses teaching others to do the same. Where are all the dads?

item.title: Crypto-Funded Chinese Peptide Labs Are Booming
item.description: Plus: Hackers use Meta’s AI bots to hack Instagram accounts, Anthropic helps NSA hackers, a decades-long GPS satellite mystery may have been solved, and more.

item.title: Has Microsoft Lost Its Mojo (Again)?
item.description: Microsoft’s AI products aren’t selling, and Github’s been plagued with troubles. WIRED spoke with VP Scott Hanselman about whether the company is in catch-up mode.

item.title: OpenAI and Anthropic May Be Rivals, but Investors Aren’t Picking Sides
item.description: “Why wouldn’t you want to be in both Pepsi and Coke?” says one venture capitalist. “It’s the same here.”
